knowledge.summary: Job is in a disabled state or without any configured schedule for more than an allowed time period.
knowledge.cause: Veeam Backup & Replication server allows disabling scheduled jobs during maintenance windows. If a job stays in a disabled state or does not have any schedule at all for more than an allowed time period, it should be enabled back or the schedule has to be configured.
knowledge.resolution: Enable all disabled jobs using the backup portal UI or the Veeam Backup & Replication console.
knowledge.custom: Per-tenant note: jobs on vbr01.tech.local are expected to be disabled during the monthly maintenance window. Verify with the customer before re-enabling.

knowledge.summary: Job has exceeded its allowed execution time.
knowledge.cause: Veeam job has exceeded the configured threshold of maximum allowed job duration.
knowledge.resolution: Verify that VMware CBT was used for all VMs in the configured backup/replication job. Check the number of read and transferred data blocks for each VM or changed files during the latest file job session, make sure your Veeam proxy servers have sufficient number of concurrently running tasks allowed. Alternatively, adjust the maximum allowed job duration threshold for this alarm. Once triggered, this alarm needs to be resolved manually.

knowledge.summary: Veeam Backup & Replication server lost connection to the proxy server.
knowledge.cause: Veeam Backup & Replication may lose connection to the backup proxy due to one of the following reasons: failure of the network cable, disconnect of the cable, failure of the physical network card, backup proxy services failure, firewall issues, backup proxy power state.
knowledge.resolution: Verify that backup proxy is accessible by Veeam Backup & Replication server. Check firewall settings on the proxy server (if applicable) and make sure Veeam backup proxy services are up and running.

knowledge.summary: Veeam Backup & Replication server lost connection to the backup repository.
knowledge.cause: Veeam Backup & Replication may lose connection to the backup repository due to one of the following reasons: failure of the network cable, disconnect of the cable, failure of the physical network card, backup repository services failure, firewall issues, backup repository power state.
knowledge.resolution: Verify that backup repository is accessible by both backup proxy and Veeam Backup & Replication servers. Check firewall settings on the proxy server (if applicable) and make sure Veeam backup repository services are up and running.
knowledge.custom: Repository sobr01.tech.local is offline by design outside business hours; investigate only if the alarm persists during the 08:00-18:00 window.

* Standalone server -- management agent is registered as non-clustered.

knowledge.summary: Job is in a disabled state or without any configured schedule for more than an allowed time period.
knowledge.cause: Veeam Backup & Replication server allows disabling scheduled jobs during maintenance windows. If a job stays in a disabled state or does not have any schedule at all for more than an allowed time period, it should be enabled back or the schedule has to be configured.
knowledge.resolution: Enable all disabled jobs using the backup portal UI or the Veeam Backup & Replication console.
knowledge.custom: Confirm the maintenance window with the customer before re-enabling jobs on vbr01.tech.local. Escalate to the on-call backup admin if the job stays disabled past the agreed window.

knowledge.summary: Job has exceeded its allowed execution time.
knowledge.cause: Veeam job has exceeded the configured threshold of maximum allowed job duration.
knowledge.resolution: Verify that VMware CBT was used for all VMs in the configured backup/replication job. Check the number of read and transferred data blocks for each VM or changed files during the latest file job session, make sure your Veeam proxy servers have sufficient number of concurrently running tasks allowed. Alternatively, adjust the maximum allowed job duration threshold for this alarm. Once triggered, this alarm needs to be resolved manually.

knowledge.summary: Veeam Backup & Replication server lost connection to the proxy server.
knowledge.cause: Veeam Backup & Replication may lose connection to the backup proxy due to one of the following reasons: failure of the network cable, disconnect of the cable, failure of the physical network card, backup proxy services failure, firewall issues, backup proxy power state.
knowledge.resolution: Verify that backup proxy is accessible by Veeam Backup & Replication server. Check firewall settings on the proxy server (if applicable) and make sure Veeam backup proxy services are up and running.

knowledge.summary: Veeam Backup & Replication server lost connection to the backup repository.
knowledge.cause: Veeam Backup & Replication may lose connection to the backup repository due to one of the following reasons: failure of the network cable, disconnect of the cable, failure of the physical network card, backup repository services failure, firewall issues, backup repository power state.
knowledge.resolution: Verify that backup repository is accessible by both backup proxy and Veeam Backup & Replication servers. Check firewall settings on the proxy server (if applicable) and make sure Veeam backup repository services are up and running.
knowledge.custom: Repository repo01.tech.local is exposed over SMB; check the firewall rule set and the VeeamTransport service before opening a ticket with the customer.

readOnly.description:

> Used with any grant type.
